description: Source code implementing MLO (Multi-Link Operation) readiness checks for endpoints, including functions to verify single valid MLO profiles and shared connection configurations.

methods.name: s_singleValidMloProfileExists
methods.description: Checks if exactly one MLO profile exists and is usable.

methods.name: s_hasSharedConnectionConf
methods.description: Checks if the endpoint has shared and applicable profile configurations with neighboring links.

methods.name: wld_epMld_isMloReady
methods.description: Determines if an endpoint is ready for MLO based on profile existence and shared configuration.
